unknown_value_action: Retain unresolved, no reinterpretation or normalization.
class_area_warning: Per-grid native cell-area proxies overlap; do not sum as distinct surveyed or habitat area.
binding_decision: Leave unbound as substrate; use only for source-quality review.

source_method_review.reported_horizontal_accuracy: Approximately ±2 m, varies with depth; producer statement, not per-cell uncertainty.
source_method_review.reported_vertical_accuracy: Approximately ±0.20 m, varies with depth; producer statement, not per-cell uncertainty.
source_method_review.depth_processing: Cleaned multibeam, SBET heave/tide correction, CUBE surface, decimated xyz and AverageGridder. Final per-cell sounding density and interpolation mask unverified.
source_method_review.rough_method: Vector ruggedness measure of the same DEM

validation.reference: Visual interpretation of shaded relief from the same DEM.

source_method_review.lineage: This block replaces earlier Vandenberg MPA-only coverage. Producer habitat, substrate, VRM, slope and TPI layers share the same bathymetry; do not count them as independent surveys.
source_method_review.artifact_mask: Narrative describes manually assigning likely-artifact exclusions to the smooth class; it does not establish modification of measured depth. No separately named georeferenced artifact mask identified in inspected archive inventory; proprietary Fledermaus scene internals were not decoded.
source_method_review.ground_truth_scope: No independent seabed video/sample product identified in inspected archive inventory. This does not establish that none exists elsewhere.

products.use: Same-campaign processed acoustic texture, not direct substrate labels or independent ground truth. Rectangular unmasked extent and zero intensities cannot establish acoustic coverage.
Same-campaign processed acoustic texture, not direct substrate labels or independent ground truth. Rectangular unmasked extent and zero intensities cannot establish acoustic coverage.

acoustic_texture_limits: Reson imagery was angle/gain-corrected and anti-aliased; SWATH imagery was amplitude-equalized, nadir-gap-filled and converted through GeoJPEG.
All six inspected TIFFs expose no NoData or valid-data mask. Zero-valued backgrounds and rectangle bounds cannot be used as measured acoustic coverage.
No calibrated dB interpretation, rock/sand classification or new independent acquisition is established.
